sentences.text: Dated : 11-09-2024  Shri Dhruv Agrawal, learned counsel for the appellant/Insurance Company.

Shri R.P.Gupta, learned counsel for respondents No. 1 to 4.
Heard on I.A.No. 5250/2024, which is an application for modification of final order dated 20/7/2024 passed by this Court in the instant appeal.

2. According to learned counsel for the appellant while arguing the matter appellant has also raised the ground that while passing the impugned award, learned Claims Tribunal has awarded interest from the date of accident; whereas, under the Motor Vehicles Act, the interest is to be payable from the date of claim petition; however this submission remained left in the final order dated 20/7/2024 due to over sight or typographical mistake.

3. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, the aforesaid submission of learned counsel for the appellant finds substance and this Court is also of the opinion that under the Motor Vehicles Act, the interest should be awarded from the date of filing of claim case and not from the date of accident.
4. Accordingly in is held that para 8 of the order dated 20/7/2024 be read as:-
"8.

The Claims Tribunal has awarded a compensation of Rs. 7,72,000/- , therefore,
same is liable to be deducted by a sum of Rs. 3,51,000/- and in 2 MA-1516-2024 case Insurance Company has made the payment of compensation amount to the claimants, it shall be at liberty to recover the same from the claimants.

The amount of compensation of Rs. 4,21,000/- for which claimants are held entitled for shall carry interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of filing of claim case."
5. I.A.No. 5250/2024 is accordingly disposed of.
6. Let this order be read in conjunction with order dated 20/7/2024 passed in instant appeal.
